plan.title: SRC-PR-029 Partial PR Quantity in Event

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation and prevent publish from being blocked by this setting.
Change the event quantity from the PR's open quantity of 10 to 6.
Confirm the event sheet retained the requested quantity of 6.
Provide the mandatory event title before publishing.
Add the vendor named in the test case.
Publish the event using the configured partial PR quantity.
Confirm publication completed and a real project page was created.
Assert that the final screen is the Purchase Requisitions area where the quantity result was inspected.
